row.notes: In Game_ChampionshipGameMode_BuildSessionSettings: mov rdx,[r14]; add rdx,0x5c; call Sess_ResolveEntityHandle; test rax,rax; je 0x1407b868c. r14 walks the entrant pointers of the current championship session (Session +0x20..+0x28, 0x88 records); rsi = the descriptor (participants +0xad8/+0xae0). A null vehicle skips the entrant (no participant). The first read of the session entrant's vehicle ref (+0x5c) on the way to the car assets; the record is re-read by Sess_Build_SessionParticipant (0x1407b882f), so a swap has to write the record's +0x5c (and +0x64) before this site, not only rdx. Research: re/research/session_vehicle_swap.md
